name: What is the warranty or guarantee on custom built-ins?

mainEntity.name: What is the warranty or guarantee on custom built-ins?

acceptedAnswer.text: We stand by the quality of our custom built-ins with a commitment to craftsmanship and durability. Specific warranty details are provided in your project contract, covering materials and workmanship for a defined period. Our goal is to ensure your complete satisfaction with the longevity and finish of your new built-ins. We address any issues arising from our installation or material defects as outlined in the agreement. This commitment offers peace of mind for your investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our custom built-ins come with a warranty covering materials and workmanship, as detailed in your project contract. We ensure satisfaction and address covered issues.
